ravi: Postmortem follow-up: condensed list of playbook changes we agreed on today. Goal = make oncall able to triage & mitigate within 10m and have clear owners for short-term fixes.

marie: Thanks. I captured three core areas: 1) triage checklist (commands + expected outputs), 2) quick mitigations (CLI runbook), 3) escalation matrix and comms template.

sam: I'll start with triage commands. Keep them minimal and copy-paste friendly. Example snippets:```
# GPU summary
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,utilization.gpu,utilization.memory,memory.used --format=csv,noheader
# runtime processes and their open files
pgrep -a redwood-runtime | xargs -r -n1 ls -l /proc/{}
# quick KV cache estimate (internal)
./bin/kv_estimate --pool dedicated-pool-2 --top=10
```

ravi: Good. Also add a one-line expected-output comment after each snippet in the runbook (e.g., "if memory.used > 90% on >1 GPU -> suspect OOM pressure").

marie: For mitigations, keep them reversible and low-risk. Proposed short steps: 1) reduce batch size, 2) divert traffic to fallback, 3) restart a shard with graceful drain. CLI examples: `redwoodctl batching set --pool dedicated-pool-2 --size 1`, `redwoodctl route create --from pool=dedicated-pool-2 --to model=redwood-small --percent 25`, `redwoodctl shard restart --shard-id s-42 --graceful`.

sam: Add an explicit note: only restart shards after routing fallback is active. Restarts can trigger cold-cache storms otherwise.

ashley: Escalation mapping proposal:
- "Investigate" (oncall): single customer report of degraded latency > 2m, p95 up 2x
- "Eng-runtime" (pager): if degraded for >10m OR OOMs on >1 node
- "Eng-sre" (pager): sustained <20% healthy capacity OR control-plane errors preventing scaling
If in doubt, page both.

ravi: Communication template for Customer Success (one paragraph): "We're investigating an infrastructure issue causing intermittent latency for your inference requests. We've enacted mitigation steps and expect partial relief within 15-30 minutes. We'll update you when normal performance resumes and after a follow-up postmortem."

marie: ACTIONS:
- ACTION: sam -> add triage snippets with example outputs into incidents/playbooks/triage_gpu_cache.md. Due: 72h.
- ACTION: ravi -> draft mitigation mini-playbook (3 steps) with exact redwoodctl commands and a rollback note. Due: 5 days.
- ACTION: ashley -> add escalation matrix and comms template into playbook; create PR template requiring owner + rollback test. Due: 3 days.

incident-bot: Note: last automated canary deploy to dedicated-pool-2 was at 1923449000. Canary run length: 0 (flag off).

sam: Recommend a lightweight canary gate before any dedicated pool promotion: deploy to 2 canary instances, run synthetic load for 10-15m, verify token-p95 and KV-growth thresholds. I'll add a sample canary.yml and a short `canary-check.sh` script snippet in the PR.

ravi: I'll also extract recurrence patterns from the last 9 incidents and attach a short table in the postmortem doc (batch size vs eviction rate). If I see a clear threshold I'll propose an automatic routing rule to lower batch size when eviction > X.

ashley: Let's do a dry-run with next week's oncall. I scheduled a 30m review: Wed 10:00 PT. Everyone who owns an action please post PR links in this thread when ready so we can walk it during the dry-run. :thumbsup:

marie: I'll include unit tests for the canary-check script (simulate KV-growth) and add a short checklist for test steps in the PR.

sam: Starting the runbook PR now, will ping here when opened.

ravi: Adding recurrence notes to the postmortem doc and will link mitigation PR when ready.

ashley: Thanks team. We'll use this thread as the authoritative tracker. If any due dates slip, update the PR and ping me.
